text:
marta: Quick heads-up: I pushed a branch for an "orphan config cleanup" preview. It flags keys with zero runtime lookups in the last 90d and surfaces them in Console for review. Want ops/telemetry/UX to eyeball before we enable deletions.

tyler: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) ensure preview runs are rate-limited (we scan a lot of keys), (2) how do we define "lookup" (runtime RPCs only or console reads count)?

marta: Preview will treat runtime RPCs (runtime -> config.lookup) and console-preview hits as usage. UI-only drafts won't count unless they trigger a lookup. We'll add an explicit `console.preview.lookup` event to capture that.

ops-bot: [job-bot] cleanup-preview started: orphan-cleanup/2024-05-07T09:30Z. job_id=oc-20240507-1 :gear:

sanjay: Telemetry: we need a clear sample stream so owners get sensible diffs. Proposal: emit `orphan_cleanup.preview.started`, `orphan_cleanup.preview.sample` (rate-limited), `orphan_cleanup.preview.summary`. Include owner, last_seen, lookup_count_90d, created_at, labels.

jess: UX: Console should show an "At-risk configs" banner in the key detail page with a 7-day reclaim CTA. Also add bulk-review modal for service owners. Copy should warn about automated prune and link to the diff.

omar: Ops wants a `no-prune` label that teams can tack on to keys (also honored by infra APIs). And we need a snapshot + tombstone approach (14d min) before any hard delete.

marta: Agreed. Policy draft: only consider keys older than 60d, surface 30-60d as "young-unused" (no delete), exclude keys with `no-prune` or any active rollout tag. We'll sample 2% of low-traffic candidates, 100% for items with last_seen > 180d and zero lookups.

tyler: For scale: implement cursored scans with per-shard backoff and a hard cap of 5k keys/hour during initial rollout. Also prefer an incremental watermark so we don't re-scan whole DB each run.

sanjay: Event payload example (we'll validate schema):

```
{
  "event": "orphan_cleanup.preview.sample",
  "key": "search.hybrid_boost.enabled",
  "owner": "search-service",
  "created_at": "2023-08-10T12:00:00Z",
  "last_seen": "2023-09-05T15:00:00Z",
  "lookups_last_90d": 0,
  "labels": ["experiment","ab_test"]
}
```

jess: For the banner CTA: button text = "Reclaim key (7d)" -> opens modal to safelist or request extension. DevEx, can you draft the modal copy?

devex: Yup will push copy to the PR. Also recommend an email digest to owners listing all their at-risk keys weekly during the preview window.

omar: Add a runbook play: emergency-undelete steps, who to page, and how to rehydrate from snapshots. Also an audit event `orphan_cleanup.delete.executed` with operator id.

marta: I'll add all that to the PR. Plan steps: 1) preview-only run + sampled telemetry + diff export, 2) Console banners + bulk review modal + safelist API, 3) `no-prune` override label, 4) deletion gated behind snapshot + 14d tombstone + ops approval, 5) staged rollout: canary account -> 10% tenants -> 100%.

tyler: One more: how do we assign owner if metadata missing? Use `owner` field, fallback to creator from audit log, then to `platform-ops` inbox. Must attach owner resolution trace to the diff so teams know source.

sanjay: I'll add schema to telemetry repo and add rate-limited ingests for the sample channel. Also suggest a counter metric `orphan_cleanup.candidates_total` and a gauge `orphan_cleanup.pending_for_owner`.

jess: UX note: show a timeline in the key's Console details: created_at, last_seen, preview_flag_time, reclaim_deadline. Helps teams decide.

omar: Ops ack, but require a pre-delete smoke job that runs a small batch of restores to verify snapshots are usable.

marta: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/orphan-cleanup/pull/21. Will leave it in preview (dry-run) until we get final thumbs from ops/devex/telemetry. Target to re-evaluate in 72h after comments.

devex: ack, will add modal copy and digest template in PR.

tyler: ack, will comment on iteration strategy and watermarking.

sanjay: ack, will add event schemas and sampling rules.

omar: ack, will draft runbook sections for undelete and operator approval.

marta: Thanks team — holding deletes until explicit ops-approved rollout and after a successful canary preview. :v:
